Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the very first step of the conversation. The task asks for the date when the winner's city (Omaha, Nebraska) became the capital of the state Knowles is from (Texas). The Planner incorrectly interpreted this as asking when Omaha became the capital of *Nebraska* (its own state), rather than checking if Omaha ever became the capital of Texas. This led to a complete misalignment of the problem, causing all subsequent steps to search for irrelevant information (Nebraska capital history) instead of the correct fact (whether Omaha was ever the capital of Texas).
